senses.gloss:
Mauktika
or Muktiyukti or Auktika or Vākyaprakāśa. gr. by Udayadharmaharṣa, disciple of Ratnasiṃha of Tapāgaccha, composed in 1451 A. D. Bomb. Uni. 81. Br. Mus. 383. Wai D. II. 9361.
--C. Sārasvata. BISM. v.. 298/7. Wai D. II. 9361.

Mauktikakārpāsikaprabandha
or Motikapāsīyāprabandha. Jain. A dialogue between a pearl an. a cotton [Page207-a. seed, by Śrīsāra, disciple of Ratnaharṣa. BORI. 40b of 1877-78. BORI. D. XIX. 2. ii. 506.

Mauktikapāsiyarāsa
Jain. JASB. NS. 1908. p. 429a (no. 7347).
Same a. Mauktikakārpāsīkaº.

Mauktikamālikā
--name of C. by Bālayajñavedeśvara on Rukmiṇīkalyāṇa of Rājacūḍāmaṇi Dīkṣita. Adyar D. V. 298. Trav. Uni. 5979.
Pt.. Adyar Library, Adyar, Madras, 1929.

Mauktikopākhyāna
or Muktisvarūpākhyāna. giving a. account of the caste of persons who deal in pearls.
--from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. Adyar. MD. 2505. 19047 (inc.). Mysore N. D. VI. 18163. Extr. p. 187.
Pt.. ed. by P. Srirama Sastri (Tel. char.). Śrī Śarvāṇī Press, Amalapuram, 1909. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1600.

Mauktirāma
father of Lakṣmaṇa, (a. of Harihaladharamaṅgala phala, RORI. XVI. 2204).
